reviews.title: Omg, the coil whine
reviews.comment: The coil whine on this thing is driving me insane. It wasn't noticeable at first but has gotten worse over 1-2 months past the return period. Don't buy this if you value your sanity -- I realize now that it was on sale for a reason. Never buying a gigabyte mobo again.
reviews.author: Tommy

reviews.title: Great looking motherboard
reviews.comment: [Employee of bestbuy] One of the best looking white/silver color motherboard in the market. Two things to consider before making the purchase. Among the 4 nvme slots. Only the 1st & 3rd slot  will give you the maximum speed. Using 2nd or 4th nvme ssd will decreased the speed of the pcie. 2nd issue is I wish the placement of the CMOS battery on this board.
reviews.author: Eico
